transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ChatGPT. What brings you in today?

I'm here because I've been having a really difficult time coping lately after a major change in my life. I've been feeling extremely overwhelmed, anxious, and down, and it feels like I just can't handle things anymore.
Did these symptoms start within a few months of the major life change, and have they been present for more than two weeks?
Yes, they started about a month and a half after everything changed. And it's definitely been going on for more than two weeks now—I've been feeling this way almost every day for the past month.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy, or has it mostly been feeling stressed and worried about the life change?

Honestly, it is really a mix of both. I feel constantly stressed and anxious about how to handle everything, but I've also lost interest in the things I used to enjoy and just feel really down most of the time.
Have you also had changes in sleep, appetite, or energy, such as sleeping much more or less than usual, eating less or more, or feeling very fatigued?
I haven't really noticed any major changes in my sleep, appetite, or energy levels. It's really more about the constant emotional stress and feeling so overwhelmed and down all the time.
Do you find yourself worrying about many different things most days, and is it hard to control the worry even when there isn’t anything specific to focus on?

Yes, I do. I've been feeling this constant nervousness and jitteriness, and it has been incredibly hard to control my anxious thoughts lately. The worry just seems to take over my mind almost every day.
How much has this been affecting your daily life, like work, school, relationships, or taking care of responsibilities?
It has been really difficult to keep up with my normal daily routine because of how overwhelmed I feel. I just feel like I am struggling to get through each day and handle my basic responsibilities.
Have you been feeling depressed or hopeless most of the day nearly every day, or do the symptoms seem mainly tied to the stress of the life change?

It definitely feels directly tied to the stress of the life change. I didn't feel depressed or hopeless like this before the transition, and these feelings really seem to stem from trying to cope with everything that happened.
Before this major life change, did you already have months of excessive worry about many different things most days, or did the anxiety start only after the change?

No, I didn't experience anything like this before. The anxiety and constant worry only started after the major life change happened. Before that, I wasn't an excessively anxious or worried person at all.
Based on what you've told me, the symptoms are most consistent with Adjustment Disorder rather than Generalized Anxiety Disorder or Major Depressive Disorder. Would you like me to explain why?

Yes, please, I would really appreciate it if you could explain that to me. I've been feeling so confused about why I'm reacting this way, so understanding why it points to Adjustment Disorder would be really helpful.
